energy: Energy: Electricity from Ofgem price cap to 2026-12, then our price cap assumption to 2027-03; gas from Ofgem price cap to 2026-12, then our price cap assumption to 2027-03; motor fuels from pump prices to 2026-11-16. Beyond those, Bank of England staff projections (November 2026 MPR).

overrides.why: Rail fares: RPI (3.2%) + 1 point formula; government has not confirmed (AJ Bell, Nov 2026)

energy_sources.04.5.2: Ofgem price cap to 2026-12, then our price cap assumption to 2027-03

price_cap_projections.why: Cornwall Insight forecast for January-March 2027: typical dual-fuel bill up 16% on October to £1,999 (cornwall-insight.com, November 2026). No electricity/gas split published, so the same % is used for both. Ofgem announces by 25 November.

backtest.note: Mean absolute error in the 12-month CPI rate (percentage points) of forecasts made each month since 2017 (excluding 2020-21), using only data available then. 'stif': no energy information; 'stif_energy': with the Ofgem price caps and pump prices known on the day; 'no_change': inflation stays at its latest rate.
